Tooltips.CheckTCR:
Sprawdzanie materiału grzałki TCR, wyłączenie tej funkcji
może wyeliminować "TCR Error" na "ciężkich" grzałkach.
Tooltips.LightSleep:
Tryb LIGHT SLEEP dla urządzeń bez drugiego oscylatora zachowuje dokładność RTC
i może pobierać więcej energii w trybie uśpienia. Użytkownik będzie ostrzegany "!"
znakiem wykrzyknika z prawej strony wskaźnika baterii.
Tooltips.Rcobc:
Włącza dodatkowe menu resetu liczników po rozłączeniu baterii,
aktualizacji firmware, loga itp. Czyszczenie statystyk wapowania.
Tooltips.RTCModeLabel:
LXT:
Umożliwia wykorzystanie wewnętrznego kryształu X32 na PCB.
Jeśli zostanie wybrana ta opcja, oprogramowanie sprzętowe spróbuje sterować zegarem czasu rzeczywistego za pomocą wbudowanego kryształu 32,768kHz.

LIRC:
Po przejściu do trybu uśpienia urządzenie podtrzymuje zegar czasu rzeczywistego korzystając z wewnętrznego oscylatora LIRC. Może być niedokładne.

LSL:
Lekki tryb uśpienia, dla urządzeń bez dodatkowego oscylatora RTC, zapewnia dokładność porównywalną z RTC.
W trybie gotowości pobiera więcej energii, dlatego użytkownik zostanie ostrzeżony znakiem "!" po prawej stronie wskaźnika baterii.
Tooltips.ShuntCorrection: Korekcja wewnętrznego rezystora miernika do wyliczania oporu grzałki.
Tooltips.UsbCharge: Aktywne lub nieaktywne ładowanie przez USB.
Tooltips.UsbNoSleep: Nie pozwala na tryb uśpienia w czasie kiedy USB jest podłączone.
Tooltips.X32: Włącza lub wyłącza korzystanie z rezonatora kwarcowego X32 na PCB.
Tooltips.Enabled: Enables or disables this profile. Disabled profiles are skipped when cycling through profiles on the device.
Tooltips.ProfileName: Name of this profile, shown on the device display when the profile is selected.
Tooltips.Power: Power output, in watts, that this profile delivers in variable-wattage mode.
Tooltips.PreheatType: How the preheat value is interpreted: Relative, a percentage of the set power; Absolute, a fixed power in watts; or Curve, a time-based power ramp.
Tooltips.PreheatPower: Power used while preheating: a percentage of the set power (Relative) or fixed watts (Absolute), applied for the preheat time at the start of a puff.
Tooltips.PreheatCurve: Power curve applied while preheating: preheat power follows this time-based ramp for the first second of the puff.
Tooltips.PreheatTime: How long preheat is applied at the start of a puff.
Tooltips.PreheatDelay: Delay between pressing the fire button and the start of preheat.
Tooltips.Resistance: Saved atomizer resistance, in ohms, used by temperature-control modes for temperature calculation.
Tooltips.VapeMode: Vaping mode for this profile: variable wattage, or temperature control with the selected coil material.
Tooltips.CoilMaterial: Coil material for temperature control. Selects the TCR coefficient the firmware uses to convert resistance change into temperature.
Tooltips.Temperature: Target coil temperature for temperature-control mode.
Tooltips.TDom: Temperature Dominant: when enabled, the temperature setting limits output power even if the power setting is higher.
Tooltips.Power1WStep: When enabled, the plus and minus buttons adjust power in whole-watt steps instead of tenths of a watt.
Tooltips.Temp1C2FStep: When enabled, the plus and minus buttons adjust temperature in 1 degree Celsius (2 degrees Fahrenheit) steps.
Tooltips.WakeUpOnPlusMinus: When enabled, pressing the plus or minus button wakes the device from sleep.
Tooltips.UpDownBehavior: Order of the plus and minus buttons: Normal or Swapped.
Tooltips.MultiClicks: Action performed when the fire button is pressed this many times in quick succession.
Tooltips.Shortcuts: Two-button shortcut: hold these two buttons together in this situation to run the selected action.
Tooltips.Brightness: Screen brightness while the device is awake.
Tooltips.IdleTime: Minutes of inactivity after which the device goes to sleep.
Tooltips.IdleTimeLocked: Minutes of inactivity after which the device goes to sleep while the keys are locked.
Tooltips.IdleTimeCharging: Minutes of inactivity after which the screen turns off while the device is charging.
Tooltips.PuffScreenDelay: How long the puff information screen stays on after a puff ends.
Tooltips.Flipped: Turns the screen content upside down, for using the device with the display facing the other way.
Tooltips.MainScreenSkin: Visual style of the main screen.
Tooltips.LogoDelay: How long the logo is shown on the main screen before the information lines appear.
Tooltips.ClockDelay: How long the clock is shown on the main screen before the information lines reappear.
Tooltips.ClockType: Clock style on the main screen: digital or analog.
Tooltips.ChargeScreen: Style of the charging screen: Classic or Extended.
Tooltips.ChargeExtra: Extra element shown on the charging screen: an analog clock, a digital clock, or the logo.
Tooltips.ScreensaverTime: Minutes of inactivity after which the screensaver starts.
Tooltips.InfoLine: Information item shown on this line of the main screen.
Tooltips.StealthMode: Stealth mode keeps the screen off while vaping; no display output, vaping continues normally.
Tooltips.ShowCharging: Shows the charging screen while stealth mode is on.
Tooltips.ShowScreensaver: Allows the screensaver to appear while stealth mode is on.
Tooltips.TemperatureUnits: Temperature units used on the device: degrees Celsius or Fahrenheit.
Tooltips.DateFormat: Date format used on the device.
Tooltips.TimeFormat: Time format used on the device: 12-hour or 24-hour.
Tooltips.SmartMode: Smart mode watches for a new atomizer and applies saved settings for it. On applies automatically, Lazy asks first, Off disables the feature.
Tooltips.SmartRange: Resistance range, in ohms, within which an atomizer is recognized as the same one.
Tooltips.PowerLimit: Maximum power, in watts, the device will output regardless of profile settings.
Tooltips.InternalResistance: Internal resistance of the device itself, in ohms, subtracted from the atomizer reading for more accurate power delivery.
Tooltips.BatteryModel: Battery model selected for voltage and percentage display and low-battery protection.
Tooltips.DeepSleepBehavior: What the device does after the deep sleep delay: just sleep, lock the keys, or turn off completely.
Tooltips.DeepSleepDelay: Minutes of inactivity before the deep sleep behavior activates.
Tooltips.ChargingCurrent: Current, in amperes, drawn over USB while charging the batteries.
Tooltips.BVO: Battery Voltage Offset: per-battery calibration correction added to the measured voltage, in volts.
Tooltips.PuffsCount: Total number of puffs taken since the counters were last reset.
Tooltips.TotalPuffsTime: Total time spent firing, summed over all puffs since the counters were last reset.
Tooltips.PuffsTimeFormat: How puff time is displayed: total seconds, or hours, minutes and seconds.
Tooltips.ProfilesTab: Vaping profiles — power, temperature control, preheat and coil settings for each profile.
Tooltips.ScreenTab: Main screen layout — what each line shows, clock, logo and brightness.
Tooltips.ControlsTab: Button behavior — fire, plus and minus clicks, shortcuts and wakeup actions.
Tooltips.SmartTab: Smart mode — automatic power based on your recent puffs.
Tooltips.AdvancedTab: Advanced settings — battery model, charging, USB, hardware and clock options.
Tooltips.ConnectDownload: Connect the device over USB and download its current configuration.
Tooltips.NewConfig: Create a new configuration from firmware defaults.
Tooltips.ConfigurationMenu: Configuration menu — create new, open existing, or save the configuration.
Tooltips.DownloadFromDevice: Read the configuration from the connected device into the editor.
Tooltips.UploadToDevice: Write the current configuration to the connected device.
Tooltips.ResetSettings: Reset the configuration to firmware defaults and upload it to the device.
Tooltips.DeviceMonitor: Open the live Device Monitor — real-time graph of power, voltage, temperature and more.
Tooltips.FirmwareEditor: Open the Firmware Editor — inspect and patch firmware images.
Tooltips.BatteryEdit: Edit the battery discharge curve (percent versus voltage).
